nodes.line: Don't stand in the doorway, mate, come round.

Someone has to, and it may as well be you. I am sending back 61 papers a day from Cheltenham and paying to have them collected, which is a business model somebody invented on purpose. I have got no proof, which is exactly why I am asking. Say nothing to anyone on the way.

You are the first person to stop all morning. They will drop my Cheltenham order if I can show $98 of turnover on the other side of the shop by grand final week. It might be nothing. It has not felt like nothing. Do not make a scene about it.
Take a breath. Then say the whole thing.

choices.text: The Better Rate, Cheltenham — that's done.

nodes.line: No dramas. Come back when you are bored.

Not being dramatic about this. I do the Cheltenham round from five in the morning and for the last fortnight somebody has been taking the papers off the front steps behind me. I would not ask if there was anyone else about. Ask for me by name at the counter.

I am told you do odd jobs. There is a dog on the Cheltenham round that has had two of my bags and a clipboard nobody signs that was not even mine. You can tell me I am imagining it. Tell me after. Come back and tell me straight.
Go on then. What did you find.

choices.text: The Dog on Ash Street, Cheltenham — that's done.

nodes.line: Right you are. Mind the step.
I know that look. Everyone wants something today.

I'll be straight with you. Nine of us at Cheltenham have gone in on the same numbers since grand final week and one of us has stopped putting money in. I would have sorted it myself a year ago. Do that and we're square.

It has been three weeks. The agency at Beecroft closed six months before Cheltenham started struggling, and I would very much like to know what they know. It is not the money. It has stopped being the money. I will owe you one, and I pay those.
You came back. That already puts you ahead.

choices.text: The Other Agency, Cheltenham — that's done.

nodes.line: Fair enough. You know where I am.

nodes.line: Half of this suburb has walked past already. Not one stopped.
